FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Ça s'écrit comment ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name?
   B. How do you spell it?
   C. And you?
   D. How are you?

2. How do you say 'Good evening, Madam!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Enchanté !
   B. Comment tu t'appelles ?
   C. Salut, Kamau !
   D. Bonsoir, Madame !

3. Which pair is correct? (1 mark)
   A. la père, la mère
   B. le père, la mère
   C. le père, le mère
   D. la père, le mère

4. How do you say 'This is my brother.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.
   B. C'est mon frère.
   C. C'est mon père.
   D. Qui est-ce ?

5. What does 'Mets' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the bag
   B. Put
   C. the bedroom
   D. the shower

6. What does 'dans' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. behind
   B. in
   C. on
   D. under

7. How do you say 'On Monday, I go to school.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.
   B. Le jeudi, je chante.
   C. Le lundi, je vais à l'école.
   D. Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?

8. How do you say 'On Friday, I dance.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Demain, c'est jeudi.
   B. Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.
   C. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   D. Le vendredi, je danse.

9. What number is 'quatorze' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 14
   C. 13
   D. 2

10. How do you say 'How old are you?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.
   B. Tu as quel âge ?
   C. Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   D. Je chante et je danse.

11. Which month is 'novembre'? (1 mark)
   A. June
   B. December
   C. November
   D. October

12. Which month is 'septembre'? (1 mark)
   A. September
   B. November
   C. March
   D. May

13. How do you say 'It is good for your health.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est bon pour la santé.
   B. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
   C. C'est une banane.
   D. J'aime la mangue.

14. What does 'la banane' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the banana
   B. rice
   C. the cake
   D. vegetables

15. How do you say 'I have a nose.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai deux mains.
   B. J'ai un nez.
   C. Il est grand.
   D. Touche ton nez !

16. How do you say 'He has short hair.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Touche ton nez !
   B. Elle a les cheveux longs.
   C. Il a les cheveux courts.
   D. J'ai deux mains.

17. What does 'Il pleut.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is windy.
   B. It is raining.
   C. It is freezing.
   D. It is cold.

18. How do you say 'What is the weather like?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait froid.
   B. Quel temps fait-il ?
   C. Il y a des nuages.
   D. Demain, il fait beau.

19. How do you say 'The TV is on the table.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.
   B. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   C. Le lit est dans la chambre.
   D. La télé est sur la table.

20. How do you say 'The fridge is in the kitchen.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Où est la clé ?
   B. Allez tout droit.
   C. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   D. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three tips for listening for the gist of a message. (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Give three French greetings and say when you would use each one. (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Explain the difference between mon and ma. Give one example of each. (4 marks) (4 marks)

24. Write a short dialogue asking for directions to the school. (4 marks) (4 marks)

25. List four things you find at a birthday party in French with un or une. (4 marks) (4 marks)

26. List the members of a nuclear family in French with le or la. Give at least five. (5 marks) (5 marks)

27. Write a role play of four lines in which you introduce your family. (4 marks) (4 marks)

28. Write the numbers from 11 to 15 in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — How do you spell it?
   Ça s'écrit comment ? means How do you spell it?.

2. D — Bonsoir, Madame !
   Good evening, Madam! in French is Bonsoir, Madame !

3. B — le père, la mère
   Père is masculine and mère is feminine.

4. B — C'est mon frère.
   This is my brother. in French is C'est mon frère.

5. B — Put
   Mets means Put.

6. B — in
   dans means in.

7. C — Le lundi, je vais à l'école.
   On Monday, I go to school. in French is Le lundi, je vais à l'école.

8. D — Le vendredi, je danse.
   On Friday, I dance. in French is Le vendredi, je danse.

9. B — 14
   quatorze means 14.

10. B — Tu as quel âge ?
   How old are you? in French is Tu as quel âge ?

11. C — November
   novembre means November.

12. A — September
   septembre means September.

13. A — C'est bon pour la santé.
   It is good for your health. in French is C'est bon pour la santé.

14. A — the banana
   la banane means the banana.

15. B — J'ai un nez.
   I have a nose. in French is J'ai un nez.

16. C — Il a les cheveux courts.
   He has short hair. in French is Il a les cheveux courts.

17. B — It is raining.
   Il pleut. means It is raining..

18. B — Quel temps fait-il ?
   What is the weather like? in French is Quel temps fait-il ?

19. D — La télé est sur la table.
   The TV is on the table. in French is La télé est sur la table.

20. D — Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   The fridge is in the kitchen. in French is Le frigo est dans la cuisine.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen for words you know; listen for the topic first; do not translate every word; listen again for details.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each tip.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Bonjour in the day, bonsoir in the evening, au revoir when leaving; salut for friends.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each greeting with a correct use.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mon is used before masculine words, for example mon père. Ma is used before feminine words, for example ma mère.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule and 1 mark for each example.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Excusez-moi, où est l'école ? Allez tout droit. Tournez à gauche. Merci ! De rien !
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for excusez-moi question, 1 mark for the instructions and 1 mark for merci and de rien.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: un gâteau, une bougie, un cadeau, un ballon
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its un or une.

26. (5 marks)
   Answer: le père, la mère, le frère, la sœur, le bébé (also l'enfant, le grand-père, la grand-mère)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its le or la.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Bonjour ! Voici ma famille. C'est ma mère. C'est mon père.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for greeting, 1 mark for voici, 1 mark for each correct C'est line.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: onze, douze, treize, quatorze, quinze
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for all correct; lose 1 mark for every two errors.
